'''challenger Poor (CCT)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[challenger]]
* '''Published:''' 31 March 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif|label=Carbon Chamber Testing}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Carbon Chamber Testing
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 CCT challenger DS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Lando Calrissian (V) (Virtual Set 6), IG-88 (V) (Virtual Set 5), The Emperor (V) (Virtual Set 6), Tarkin (V) (Virtual Set 3), Special Delivery (V) (Virtual Set 6), Imperial Decree (V) (Virtual Set 6), Hyperwave Scan (V) (Virtual Set 3), Despair (V) (Virtual Set 6), Ability, Ability, Ability (V) (Virtual Set 6), A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Set 4): not in GEMP)

You know, dude. Beats.

== Notes ==

* The Interrupts header says 11 but the list has 13 (the total is 60).
* Original-era (V): Hyperwave Scan (V) (Virtual Set 3); Tarkin (V), A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Set 4); IG-88 (V) (Virtual Set 5); Special Delivery (V), Lando Calrissian (V), The Emperor (V), Imperial Decree (V), Despair (V), Ability, Ability, Ability (V) (Virtual Set 6).
* Posted Cloud City: Carbon Chamber dested Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber; Carbon Chamber Console dested Carbonite Chamber Console; Hoth: Wampa Cave dested Hoth: Wampa Cave (7th Marker). Security Precautions is unmarked, so it is the printed card.
* Original-era printing corrected: Tarkin (V) (Virtual Set 4) -> Tarkin (V) (Virtual Set 3) (an earlier dest had linked the modern virtual card of the same name).

== Strategy ==

Well, use Double Back to get out Iggy and start Tunnel Visioning once per turn, you want to pull a Hutt Smooch/Stunning Leader quickly to avoid nasty spy beats. Then, just beat on opponent. Pull Executor at start of game, when you get Thrawn and have enough force you can drop them on some poor blighter. Drop First Strike when opp has no force left and you’re looking for the beat, besides that and the bullets you’re going to want to get all your effects out, probably Despair (V) first. Drop Lando (V) at the prison when Iggy is there. Just beat.
